items.description: One of the most popular zoos in Mexico, located inside Chapultepec Park. It houses a diverse collection of Mexican and international wildlife.
A well-known zoological park in Mexico City, focusing on species native to the Mexican Basin.
One of the largest zoos in Mexico, known for its panoramic views and open-habitat exhibits.
A major underground aquarium located in Mexico City, featuring thousands of aquatic species.
An eco-archaeological park in the Riviera Maya that showcases Mexican nature, culture, and marine life.
A popular safari-style park near Puebla where animals roam freely in large open habitats.
A large wildlife park in the State of Mexico, designed as a safari-type experience for families.
A UNESCO World Heritage site where millions of monarch butterflies spend the winter.
A protected biosphere reserve in the Yucatan Peninsula, known for its incredible biodiversity.
A vast tropical forest reserve and archaeological site, home to diverse jungle wildlife.
